title: WesterosCraft
description: A recreation of the continent Westeros based on George R.R. Martin's epic fantasy series A Song of Ice and Fire
body: --- ![WesterosCraft ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f05dc33630d9c0e09f3eba460b4bde3a9a674e77.png) ## Explore the world of Westeros inside Minecraft This modpack includes everything you need to explore the [WesterosCraft](https://westeroscraft.com/) creative server or start your own Westerosi or medieval themed creations. Explore a meticulously crafted virtual realm inspired by George R.R. Martin's epic fantasy world. From King's Landing to Winterfell, our immersive Minecraft server offers a stunning, player-driven recreation of the Seven Kingdoms. ## Wander through iconic locations: Explore the grandeur of King's Landing, from the Red Keep to the bustling Flea Bottom. Traverse the icy plains beyond the Wall. Unwind in the sun-drenched fields of Highgarden, or climb the perilous cliffs of Casterly Rock. Visit hundreds of holdfasts, towns, and landmarks from the pages of _A Song of Ice and Fire_, all brought to life in hand-crafted detail. - Attention to detail: Every castle, town, and landscape feature is crafted to be as accurate to the books as possible. - Custom-built modpack: WesterosCraft features a curated selection of mods that enhance the experience without straying from the lore. This includes WesterosBlocks, our custom block mod that adds 1500+ new blocks to the game. - Regular updates: The world is constantly evolving, with new locations and features added all the time. ![The Wall from A Game of Thrones made in Minecraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9792babcafa0e3aafe04fc60e5dd26656ee42c57_0.webp)
